channels.addressEmail: The address people write to, such as info@frigear.nu.
channels.addressForm: The slug of the form, such as contact.
channels.addressInstagram: The id of the Instagram professional account.
channels.addressMessenger: The id of the Facebook page.
channels.addressOther: The identity of the mailbox on this channel.
channels.addressWhatsapp: The phone number id of the WhatsApp Business number (not the phone number).
channels.description: Messages to this address land in the mailbox, and replies go out the same way.
channels.enabledHelp: A channel that is off drops new messages and sends no replies.
channels.fieldsHelp: The field keys of the name, email and message. Defaults: name, email, message.
channels.replyToHelp: Where answers to replies go. Defaults to the address above, or the mailbox's email address.
channels.secretRefHelp: Upper case letters, digits and "_", such as WHATSAPP_TOKEN.
channels.secretRefMeta: The name of the access token in the server config: inbox.secrets.<NAME> or NUXT_INBOX_SECRET_<NAME>.
channels.secretRefOptional: Only for channels that need a token of their own.

composer.notePlaceholder: Write a note for the team. It is never sent.
composer.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply. It goes out by {channel}.
composer.title: Answer

contact.eraseDescription: Their name, email address and phone number are removed and every message in their threads is blanked. The threads stay, empty. This cannot be undone.
contact.name: Name
contact.piiHidden: Contact details are only shown to people allowed to see them.
contact.title: Contact

dashboard.mineHint: Open threads waiting for your answer
dashboard.unassignedHint: Open threads nobody has picked up

hide.description: People without the role no longer see the thread, as if it did not exist. Its assignee is dropped when they lack the role.
hide.everyone: Everyone with access to the mailbox
hide.label: Who sees the thread
hide.title: Hide from lower roles

list.description: Messages from the contact form, email, WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, answered from one place.
list.emptyDescription: Messages show up here once a channel is connected to a mailbox you read.
list.forbidden: You do not have access to the inbox
list.loadFailed: The inbox could not be loaded
list.title: Inbox

admin.description: Messages from the contact form, email, WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.
admin.label: Inbox

permissions.assignDescription: Assign threads to the people who answer them.
permissions.channelsDescription: Connect the contact form, email addresses, WhatsApp numbers and Meta pages to mailboxes.
permissions.hideDescription: Hide a thread from everybody below one of your own roles.
permissions.inboxAuditPiiDescription: See who viewed, answered, assigned, hid, exported and erased what.
permissions.manageDescription: Create, edit and delete mailboxes, read every mailbox and erase contacts.
permissions.piiDescription: See the email address, phone number and channel id of the people who write in, and export their data.
permissions.readDescription: Read the threads of the mailboxes you have access to.
permissions.replyDescription: Reply to the threads of the mailboxes you have access to, write internal notes and change their status.

settings.addMailboxDescription: A shared inbox. Connect channels to it once it is created.
settings.channelsDescription: Each connects an address on a channel to a mailbox. Tokens stay in the server config.
settings.channelsFailed: The channels could not be loaded
settings.channelsForbidden: Only admins signed in with a session manage channels
settings.deleteMailboxDescription: Its channels are disconnected. A mailbox that still has threads cannot be deleted.
settings.description: Mailboxes, who reads them, and the channels that deliver into them.
settings.disconnectDescription: New messages to it are dropped. Its threads stay in the mailbox, but replies to them can no longer be sent.
settings.keyDescription: A stable name for code and seeds, such as support.
settings.mailboxesFailed: The mailboxes could not be loaded
settings.name: Name
settings.noChannelsDescription: Connect the contact form, an email address, a WhatsApp number or a Meta page.
settings.noMailboxesDescription: Add a shared mailbox, such as Support, then connect channels to it.
settings.ownerHelp: A team mailbox is read by the team's leads.
settings.readersHelp: Staff who manage inboxes always do. A platform mailbox needs at least one rule.
settings.retentionHelp: Days after the last message. Leave empty for the default.
settings.title: Inbox settings

thread.loadFailed: The thread could not be loaded
thread.removed: Removed under the retention policy or on request.

visibility.operation: Only people taking part in operation
visibility.teamRoleHelp: A team kind and a role of its ladder, such as bar and ba.
